t: A rugged, card-sized LoRa tracker with GPS, a screen, and a big battery.
steps: Buy the T1 from the Heltec store or OpenELAB. Pick the band for your country, such as 915 MHz in the US.
Charge it over the waterproof USB-C port.
Hold the power button for 3 seconds to turn it on and try the stock F&T firmware.
To switch to Meshtastic, double-click the power button to enter flashing mode.
Drag the Meshtastic heltec-mesh-node-t1 UF2 file onto the drive that appears.
Install the Meshtastic app on your phone and pair over Bluetooth.
Set your region and send a first message to a friend's node.
